description: Host composition framework for .NET. Components declare their services, configuration and contributions, profiles select the roles each process runs, and a misconfigured host fails at startup with diagnostics that name the owners.
Testing support for Corfedo Troupe: verify every declared profile with real hosts, compose a slice of components and replace services with recorded test ownership.
ASP.NET Core integration for Corfedo Troupe: middleware stages, endpoints and named Kestrel endpoints declared by components, with startup checks for the pipeline and endpoint configuration.
